notes: Known-adversarial fuzz files. Each entry lists files matched by path_glob (relative to --content-path), the expected demo exit code, and one or more stderr substrings the wrapper must see for the failure to count as a correct rejection. The path_glob supports '*' wildcards and '[a-b]' character ranges. Paths use forward slashes for matching; backslashes in real paths are normalized before comparison. If skip_perf is true, OverallThroughput and PerStageTiming tests are skipped for matching files (perf can't measure what won't decode). Signatures cross-validated across TestLab builds 151782860, 151831983, 151861651 (3 builds × 6-7 machines per build); build 151753278 was excluded because it predates the CSV-mangling fix and had different observed behavior. NOTE: some machines (observed on ARM64 / DSTESTPC1) crash with exit code -1073741819 (ACCESS_VIOLATION) on D3D12DebugLayer scenarios for adversarial input at a ~15% rate instead of graceful rejection — those tests will fail the manifest exit-code check by design, which is the correct signal to flag as a demo bug.
